item.description: The normalize_path function currently doesn't properly handle several edge cases including: consecutive dots in paths, Unicode characters, and complex path normalization scenarios like "../path/to" or "././path/to". The implementation doesn't fully comply with RFC 3986 for path normalization.
item.contract: Implement a robust normalize_path function that correctly handles all edge cases from RFC 3986, including: - Proper handling of "." and ".." segments - Preservation of absolute paths (starting with "/") - Handling of Unicode characters and special symbols - Correct processing of sequences like "././path/to" and "../path/to" - Proper handling of empty segments and trailing dots - Return correct normalized paths according to RFC 3986 specifications
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_normalize_path.py should pass, specifically: - test_normalize_path[path/to/.-path/to/] - test_normalize_path[\\u03bc\\u03bf\\u03bd\\u03bf\\u03c0\\u03ac\\u03c4\\u03b9/../../\\u03bd\\u03b1/\\U0001d566\\U0001d55f\\U0001d55a/\\U0001d554\\U0001d560\\U0001d555\\U0001d556/.-\\u03bd\\u03b1/\\U0001d566\\U0001d55f\\U0001d55a/\\U0001d554\\U0001d560\\U0001d555\\U0001d556/] - test_normalize_path[///-///] - test_normalize_path[/foo/../../../ton-/ton] - test_normalize_path[../path/to-path/to]

item.description: The joinpath method and related path joining functionality doesn't correctly handle empty segments, trailing slashes, and dot sequences. The implementation needs to properly follow RFC 3986 for URL path joining behavior.
item.contract: Implement proper URL path joining that correctly handles: - Empty segments in paths - Trailing slashes and their effect on path resolution - Dot sequences like "./", "../" in path joining - RFC 3986 compliant path joining behavior for relative paths - Correct handling of absolute vs relative paths when joining
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_url.py should pass, specifically: - test_joinpath_empty_segments[empty-segments_empty-segment] - test_join_path_normalized[path-path] - test_join_path_normalized[path/././to-path/to] - test_join_from_rfc_3986_normal[../-http://a/b/] - test_join_from_rfc_3986_abnormal[g/../h-http://a/b/c/h]

item.description: The cache configuration and clearing mechanisms are not implemented properly. The cache system lacks proper configuration, clearing, and info retrieval functions.
item.contract: Implement proper cache management functions: - cache_clear() to clear all caches - cache_info() to retrieve cache statistics - cache_configure() to configure cache sizes for different components - Proper handling of deprecated parameters with appropriate warnings - Support for all cache components (idna_encode, idna_decode, ip_address, host_validate, encode_host)
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_cache.py should pass, specifically: - test_cache_clear - test_cache_info - test_cache_configure_default - test_cache_configure_None_including_deprecated - test_cache_configure_None_only_deprecated
